critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~1100-line module; consider splitting routers (auth, workouts, coach, billing) as it grows.
Auth: /auth/google/session passes through any session_token that Emergent returns; ensure expires_at from emergent provider is preserved rather than defaulting to +7d (currently hard-coded).

/coach/chat builds prior history list but never actually replays it into the LlmChat — the for-loop is a no-op (history[:-1] does nothing). Multi-turn memory therefore relies only on the system message snapshot, not the real chat history beyond the current message.
weekly-report extracts JSON with brittle string slicing; consider using a more robust JSON extractor and a Pydantic model for shape validation.

rca_of_issue: Login navigation: login.tsx calls signInAsDemo() which sets user state in AuthContext and persists token, but the screen never re-evaluates routing because (a) there is no useEffect watching `user` to call router.replace, and (b) root layout has no auth guard. Result: user is authenticated but visually stuck on /login. Reproduction: visit /login → tap Demo button → URL remains /login indefinitely. Token confirmed stored in localStorage and GET /api/auth/me returns user. Fix: in login.tsx add `useEffect(() => { if (user) router.replace('/'); }, [user])` OR navigate explicitly inside onPress handlers after await signInAsDemo().
